adaptation_notes: Base model is explicitly recorded and loaded fresh; previous fine-tuned weights are not reused.
Both arms start fresh from Qwen2.5-0.5B Base, use at most ten epochs, global batch 64, four GPUs with micro batch 8 and accumulation 2.
Cosine spans the requested epoch budget with 20 warmup steps; ranking mode selects/early-stops by full-validation NDCG@10 and independently retains Recall@10 best weights.
Original data tasks and original evaluation prompt are retained; DDP placement, monitoring, provenance, complete coverage and constrained-decoding boundaries adapt the workflow to four GPUs.
DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 and gradient checkpointing are identical across both arms.
The augmented arm adds one title-history-to-next-SID sample for each original training interaction; equal epochs therefore do not imply equal optimizer steps.

progress.grad_norm_definition: unscaled global full-model L2 norm before gradient clipping
